response_quality_semantics: A burned-pilot spatial block is response-qualified only when the held-out block retains at least the frozen minimum_test_rows applicable species-by-atoll targets after all response-blind target eligibility and source-designated complete-inventory rules are applied. Atolls missing frozen R0/R1 safe covariates were excluded before response access. A block with no catalogue-qualified atoll or no applicable training-defined species is represented as non-estimable and may not be rescued, substituted, imputed, merged, or have its threshold lowered after pilot opening.
